messages:
Sam Nguyen: Hey — enterprise prospect (FinTech) just sent a security questionnaire asking for our breach notification timeline and the IR process. They want to confirm we can meet 'contractual 72-hour notification' and have a customer-facing timeline. Any language we can share?

Priya Patel: Short version: we have a documented incident response program + SOC 2 and runbooks. For notification we align with contractual terms; our standard is to notify impacted customers as soon as practicable after we confirm a security incident and have actionable details. For GDPR-type incidents we typically target initial notification within 72 hours of confirmation. :shield:

Sam Nguyen: Can we commit 72 hours in a contract? Customer is pushing hard.

Luis Romero: Caveat: we never promise to notify before we have enough info to be accurate. Suggest language: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to notify Customer of a confirmed security incident impacting Customer data within 72 hours of confirmation. Notification timing may vary pending legal or law enforcement guidance." That keeps it realistic.

Nina Chen: Also include our escalation path + single point of contact for enterprise deals. Customers like to see a 24/7 on-call contact for high severity incidents. We can offer SLA add-on for 1-hour acknowledgement for Sev1 under Dedicated contracts.

Sam Nguyen: Good — they also asked for evidence: runbook, tabletop exercise cadence, root-cause reporting (RCA) timeline. What do we share?

Priya Patel: We can provide a redacted IR runbook excerpt and our exercise cadence: annual tabletop + quarterly service-specific drills for Dedicated customers. RCA draft typically within 30 days; final report depends on investigation but aim for 60-90 days for complex incidents.

Luis Romero: Paste short runbook snippet (redacted):

```
Triage (0-4h): initial detection, scope estimate, severity classification
Containment (4-24h): isolate affected nodes, temporary mitigations
Notification (24-72h): prepare customer notice, legal review, external comms
Remediation (72h+): apply fixes, validate, begin root cause analysis
Postmortem (30-90d): RCA, mitigations, follow-up actions
```

Sam Nguyen: Perfect. They also want confirmation on breach notification channels (email, portal, phone) and whether we will notify regulatory authorities.

Nina Chen: Channels: primary via the customer's designated security contact + account team, and we post an incident advisory in the customer portal for Dedicated/Private. For regulated notifications, we coordinate with customer's legal/compliance team — we don't unilaterally notify regulators on behalf of customers unless contractually authorized. We will support and provide all required artifacts to help customers meet their regulatory obligations.

Sam Nguyen: Legal asked for exact phrasing to include in the contract.

Luis Romero: Proposed contract clause (short): "Upon confirmation of a Security Incident affecting Customer Data, Redwood will notify Customer without undue delay and, when feasible, within seventy-two (72) hours of confirmation of such incident. Redwood's notification obligations are subject to constraints to avoid impeding law enforcement or its investigation. Redwood will provide reasonable cooperation to Customer in fulfilling any regulatory reporting obligations."

Legal Bot: +1 to Luis' clause. Add: "Notification will include the nature of the incident, impacted data, mitigation steps, and point of contact."

Priya Patel: Also note: for POC environments or trial orgs in hosted sandbox, we generally have limited SLA/notification commitments — call that out separately.

Sam Nguyen: Last Q from customer: do you publish an incident timeline / historical record?

Nina Chen: We maintain internal incident logs and provide post-incident reports to affected customers on a need-to-know basis. We do not publish a public incident timeline unless it's a broad platform incident affecting many customers; in that case we will publish a public advisory and postmortem on the status page.

Sam Nguyen: Thanks — I'll send them the runbook snippet + clause + note about dedicated SLAs and contact matrix. Anyone want to review the email before I send?

Luis Romero: I can review in 30 mins.

Priya Patel: Happy to review for technical accuracy.

IR Bot: Incident response templates and redacted runbook are attached: https://internal.redwood/ir/templates (access: eng-security).

Sam Nguyen: Awesome, thanks team :raised_hands:
